Great — thanks for the detail, Sara. Quick back-of-envelope cost scenarios based on your numbers so we're aligned before I draft a formal quote: 

Assumptions: hosted API list-rate approx $30 per 1M tokens (example unit price: $0.03 per 1k tokens).

Scenarios (monthly cost):
- No-commit hosted (list): 15M tokens -> ~$450/month; 30M -> ~$900/month.
- Committed discount (example 20% for committed monthly minimum): 15M -> ~$360/month; 30M -> ~$720/month.

If you're targeting $30-$40 /1M, list-rate maps into that range — and with a modest commitment we can get you down toward the low end ($24/1M if we apply a 20% credit).

On peak TPS: 10 TPS spikes are within what hosted can handle with burst capacity. If you're looking for guaranteed sustained throughput at high TPS with tighter latency/SLAs, Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) can be more predictable and sometimes cheaper per-token at high committed volumes (we'll include that cost comparison in the quote).

Next steps I'll take now: 
1) Draft a one-page quote with three lines: no-commit hosted, 6-month committed, Dedicated recommendation + cost/benefit note.
2) Alex — can you add a note on rate limits and burst settings we should recommend for FintechCo (10 TPS spikes, 2s latency target)?
3) Marissa — can you confirm whether a 20% commit discount is OK to propose on the draft, or suggest the appropriate discount band for this ARR profile?

I'll attach the draft quote and send it back to you by EOD. Thanks —

Ben
